name: Does the Dog Die
description: Shows community-sourced content warnings from DoesTheDogDie.com when playback starts.
overview: Content warnings from DoesTheDogDie.com at the start of playback.

versions.changelog: 1.1.0.0: per-user and per-library toggles on the settings page.

name: Path Tagger
description: Automatically tags items by folder path, for per-user visibility via blocked tags.
overview: Tag items by folder path for per-profile visibility in shared libraries.

versions.changelog: Initial release: folder-to-tag mappings, scheduled sweep task, immediate tagging of new items.

name: Pause Tracker
description: Tracks how many times playback is paused and for how long, and shows the totals in the video OSD.
overview: Pause count and accumulated paused time in the player overlay.

versions.changelog: 1.2.0.0: fix summary firing on OSD auto-hide, fix duplicate OSD entries, add pre-roll grace threshold (default 3 min).

name: Showtime
description: CinemaVision-style pre-show sequences: trivia, trailers, bumpers, ratings and audio-format cards, and light cues.

versions.changelog: 0.2.2.0: fix content folders on Windows; skip 3D clips for 2D features.
